title: Distinct Subsequences II
goal: Count distinct nonempty subsequences of a lowercase string.
strategy: Appending a character creates total+1 subsequences ending in that character. Replace the old ending-character contribution rather than adding it again, which removes duplicates caused by earlier copies.

edgeCases: One repeated letter creates one subsequence per length
Distinct characters generate every nonempty selection
Alternating repeats create overlapping duplicate texts
